compiled_state.title: [ci-llm-review-runner]: Inconclusive main-tier response -> security overlay not dispatched, job exits 0
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
ci-llm-review-runner.sh in CI run 25186884004 on PR #28 (branch test/security-overlay-v3-1777579706):
- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set; Anthropic API is called for the main tier review
- API returns a valid HTTP response but the LLM text is not valid reviewer-findings JSON
- Fail-open behavior at lines 352-355 sets FINDINGS_JSON to inconclusive (score=5, all N/A)
- Security overlay ($_SEC) depends on the classifier's security_overlay flag
- If classifier set _SEC=false (likely: fixture has DELIBERATE-TEST-VIOLATION comments), overlay never runs
- Job exits 0 (passed) even though docs/security-overlay-test-fixture.sh contains sk-... credential pattern

Expected: job exits non-zero because security overlay detects credential
Actual: job exits 0 with inconclusive review, security overlay not run

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE). Security overlay not dispatched when main-tier LLM response is inconclusive.
comments.author: Test

comments.body:
INVESTIGATION RESULT:
ROOT_CAUSE: _compute_security_overlay() in review-complexity-classifier.sh (line 627) has no API key pattern detection. The grep checks for (password|secret|token|credential|certificate) but misses common API key formats: sk-... (OpenAI), AKIA... (AWS), _API_KEY= assignments, etc. The fixture line FAKE_OPENAI_KEY="sk-FAKE-TEST-ONLY-..." does not match any current pattern, so security_overlay=false is returned, the overlay is never dispatched, and the CI job exits 0 (passed).
confidence: high
hypothesis_tests:
  - test: current pattern does NOT match fixture line → CONFIRMED (grep returned no match)
  - test: new pattern (sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,} + _API_KEY=[val]) DOES match fixture line → CONFIRMED
proposed_fix: Add API key prefix patterns to _compute_security_overlay() grep at line 627
